claims.quote: KCNT1 encodes a sodium-activated potassium channel (Slack channel)
we describe one heterozygous KCNT1 mutation, M267T, in a patient with EIMFS.
Wild-type or mutant KCNT1 plasmids were expressed heterologously in Xenopus laevis oocytes
The single-channel properties were investigated using the excised inside-out patches from HEK293T cells.

claims.object_text: in utero electroporation expression in hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons in male mice
claims.quote: Through in utero electroporation, WT and M267T Slack channels were expressed in the hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons in male mice
The KCNT1 M267T mutation enhanced Slack channel function by increasing single-channel open probability.

claims.object_text: affected afterhyperpolarization properties and induced neuronal hyperexcitability
claims.quote: the KCNT1 M267T mutation in the mouse hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons affected afterhyperpolarization properties and induced neuronal hyperexcitability, which was inhibited by carvedilol.
carvedilol effectively reversed the mutation-induced gain-of-function channel properties.
carvedilol exhibited antiseizure effects in the kainic acid-induced epilepsy model.
